lines.l: One love, one love, one love, one love
Two years are better than what he said
Love lets it rain, lets it rain
These tears are stronger than what you gain
Give me one love, one love, one love
Make a dream for love, for love, for love, for love
But I want one love, one love, one and one love for you
One love, one love, one love, one love for you
One love, one love, one love, one love of you
Oh, when I'm stuck in the middle
Oh, when I'm stuck in the middle
